name: HoverOverMenuItem
description: Skill to hover over a specified menu item.
precondition: The menu item with the specified ID is visible.
success_predicate: Hover over the visible menu item completed

execution_plan.fallback: click on the menu item instead
execution_plan.success_check: Verify that the hover action is recognized by the UI

name: OpenFeedbackSection
description: A skill to open the user feedback section.
precondition: User is on the feedback page.

execution_plan.fallback: click the default feedback section button
execution_plan.success_check: Check if the feedback section is displayed

name: SelectCategory
description: Select a specified category from the menu.

execution_plan.fallback: try to refresh the menu and click again
execution_plan.success_check: Verify that the selected category is highlighted
